offer of commanderies was refused by Shizong

translationRepairs: On yichou an edict declared that monks holding more than ten qing of official land would have it registered to the state and divided among the poor.
On yichou an edict declared that those in Shanhou who had illegally seized more than ten qing of official land would have it registered to the state and divided among the poor.
山后冒占官地 refers to people of Shanhou who illegally occupied official land; no monks are mentioned.
In the eighth month, on yichou, Right Deputy Palace Inspector Hushen and others were sent as Song birthday envoys, and Personnel Section Chief Xi Husihai as Western Xia birthday envoy.
In the eighth month, on yichou, Right Deputy Palace Inspector Hushilai and others were sent as Song birthday envoys, and Personnel Section Chief Xi Husihai as Western Xia birthday envoy.
Supervising censors Shi Mo Yuanli and Zheng Daqing, who had failed to impeach, were each beaten forty strokes; every earlier envoy was punished as the law required.
Supervising censors Shimo Yuanli and Zheng Daqing, who had failed to impeach, were each beaten forty strokes; every earlier envoy was punished as the law required.
石抹 is the Khitan surname Shimo, written as one word.

In the ninth month, on jisi, Fang Deng, associate administrator of the Imperial Clan Court, was sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday, and duty-night general Wanyan Xielihu for Xia’s birthday.

In the ninth month, on jisi, Fang, associate administrator, and others of the Imperial Clan Court, was sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday, and duty-night general Wanyan Xielihu for Xia’s birthday.
方等 means Fang and others; 等 is not part of the name.
In the eighth month, on guihai, Grand Storehouse Supervisor Zhang Dajie and others were sent as Song birthday envoys, and Censor-in-Chief Yaoli Temuge as Western Xia birthday envoy.
In the eighth month, on guihai, Grand Storehouse Supervisor Zhang Dajie and others were sent as Song birthday envoys, and Attending Censor Yaoli Temuge as Western Xia birthday envoy.
侍御史 is an Attending Censor, not the Censor-in-Chief (御史大夫).

On bingyin Left Chancellor Wanyan Shoudao, Left Vice Councillor Zhang Rubi, Right Vice Councillor Zhagewo Hutela, and Participation Councillor Zhang Rulin, for having on their own increased the Eastern Palace imperial grandsons’ rations, were each demoted one rank.

On bingyin Left Chancellor Wanyan Shoudao, Left Vice Councillor Zhang Rubi, Right Vice Councillor Niange Watele, and Participation Councillor Zhang Rulin, for having on their own increased the Eastern Palace imperial grandsons’ rations, were each demoted one rank.
粘割斡特剌 is Niange Watele, as elsewhere in this chapter.

On jiaxu regulations increased the monthly salaries of military commissioners, circuit commanders, grand marshals, pacification commissioners, transport commissioners, prefects, transport agents, and military governors.

On jiaxu regulations increased the monthly salaries of regents, army commanders, area commanders, pacification commissioners, transport commissioners, prefects, transport agents, and military governors.
留守、統軍、總管 are regents, army commanders and area commanders, not military commissioners and grand marshals.
Right Vice Councillor Zhagewo Hutela said former Envoy-Section Minister Tangque Gong would do, and he was appointed to the post.
Right Vice Councillor Niange Watele said former Envoy-Section Minister Tangkuo Gong would do, and he was appointed to the post.
粘割斡特剌 is Niange Watele; 唐括 is the Tangkuo clan.
Taizu attacked Macheng by surprise; when mud bogged his horse he dismounted and went on foot; Huandu shot Macheng and took him.
Taizu attacked Machan by surprise; when mud bogged his horse he dismounted and went on foot; Huandu shot Machan and took him.
On wuwu Left Police Patrol deputy commissioner Husha Tongmin, for sound judgments, was promoted to palace attendant censor and concurrent chief clerk of the Right Three Bureaus.
On wuwu Left Police Patrol deputy commissioner Husha, perceptive and sound in judgment, was promoted to palace attendant censor and concurrent chief clerk of the Right Three Bureaus.
通敏善斷 describes Husha (鶻沙) as perceptive and decisive; Tongmin is not part of his name.
Because Palace Attendance Bureau director Nimuguci Jian Chunzhi was forthright and penetrating, he was promoted to attendant of the imperial great-grandson heir.
Because Palace Attendance Bureau director Nimuguci Jian was pure, forthright, and penetrating, he was promoted to attendant of the imperial great-grandson heir.
純直通敏 is a description; Chunzhi is not part of the name.
On gengshen Right Chief Councillor Prince of Yuan Jing was made imperial great-grandson heir.
On gengshen Right Chief Councillor Prince of Yuan Jing was made imperial grandson heir.
皇太孫 is the imperial grandson heir.
Left Vice Director Niange Hutela said, "We dare not fail to do all we can; it is only that our talent falls short and we cannot fill the office.”
Left Vice Director Niange Watele said, "We dare not fail to do all we can; it is only that our talent falls short and we cannot fill the office.”
斡特剌 is Niange Watele, as elsewhere in this chapter.
On xinhai the imperial great-grandson was invested; an amnesty was proclaimed.
On xinhai the imperial grandson heir was invested; an amnesty was proclaimed.
皇太孫 is the imperial grandson heir.
The emperor turned to Right Vice Director Zhang Rubi and said, “Former ages had so many loyal remonstrators; why are there so few today?”
The emperor turned to Right Vice Director Zhang Rulin and said, “Former ages had so many loyal remonstrators; why are there so few today?”
張汝霖 is Zhang Rulin, not Zhang Rubi.
Rubi replied, “In ages of disorder loyal words advance; in ages of peace loyal words have nowhere to apply.”
Rulin replied, “In ages of disorder loyal words advance; in ages of peace loyal words have nowhere to apply.”
In the seventh month, on xinhai, Left Vice Director Zhagewo Hutela left office.
In the seventh month, on xinhai, Left Vice Director Niange Watele left office.
粘割斡特剌 is Niange Watele, as elsewhere in this chapter.
It admonished the imperial great-grandson to cultivate virtue and hold firm to his charge, and charged Grand Marshal and Left Chief Councillor Kening to guide him with loyal devotion.
It admonished the imperial grandson heir to cultivate virtue and hold firm to his charge, and charged Grand Marshal and Left Chief Councillor Kening to guide him with loyal devotion.
皇太孫 is the imperial grandson heir.
On yiyou he ordered Imperial Great-Grandson Jing to govern as regent from the east wing of Qinghe Hall.
On yiyou he ordered Imperial Grandson Heir Jing to govern as regent from the east wing of Qinghe Hall.
皇太孫 is the imperial grandson heir.
The imperial great-grandson ascended the throne.
The imperial grandson heir ascended the throne.
皇太孫 is the imperial grandson heir.

He lived plainly, exalted filial piety and brotherhood, trusted reward and punishment, valued farming, chose magistrates carefully, inspected integrity sternly, refused Ren Dedao's petition to partition the realm and Zhao Weichong's gift of commanderies as fiefs, and governed tirelessly day and night—this was the way of a true ruler.

He lived plainly, exalted filial piety and brotherhood, trusted reward and punishment, valued farming, chose magistrates carefully, inspected integrity sternly, refused Ren Dejing's petition to partition his state (Western Xia) and Zhao Weichong's gift of commanderies as fiefs, and governed tirelessly day and night—this was the way of a true ruler.
任得敬 is Ren Dejing, the Western Xia minister who sought to divide Xia.
